name: Tamar
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Tamar, widowed twice, was sent back to her father's house until Shelah was grown; there was no cougaring in the Bible, and when Judah did not keep his promise she sat veiled by the road to Timnath.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: When Judah heard Tamar was with child by whoredom he said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt. A woman promised in the covenant that plays the harlot and brings an heir by another disobeys the law of the Most High, and her reproach is not blotted out; that is why the judgment was so heavy.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
